# .claude/skills after `skm integrations apply` (ownership managed_file; one record per file in projection_files)
.claude/skills/
├── skm-planning/                 # core skill (integrations.skills.include_core = true)
│   ├── SKILL.md                  # frontmatter: name, description (≤ 1536 chars in the listing) + body
│   └── references/
│       └── plan-schema.md
├── skm-memory/
│   └── SKILL.md
├── python-testing/               # integrations.skills.presets = ["python"] → closure over requires
│   └── SKILL.md
└── team-release-notes/           # NOT managed: created by a person; skm never reads, changes or removes it
    └── SKILL.md
# A file of a managed skill edited by hand → next apply writes <file>.skm-new and the projection becomes drifted.
# A skill removed from the selection → REMOVE_OWNED if unchanged since our write, LEAVE_MODIFIED otherwise.
